items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I had my uncle John, married to a lady by the name of Leela Johnson... And their children all were taught -- were sent to music school.

ctx.x: celebration for her when she retired, and everything. But she had the number one choir there. They had three or four choirs, and she had the number one choir for years.

Now, of course, I had my uncle John, married to a lady by the name of Leela Johnson, who was the first cousin of Jack Johnson, the prize fighter. And their children all were taught -- were sent to music school. Now the oldest girl was Nannie Mae. She played mostly classical music. And ironically, her daughter-- she had one daughter and one son, they lived in Chicago, is a featured artist with the Chicago symphony. And she's also the president of some music association. She travels all over the country. Some kind…
